verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API platform. A built-in AI assistant (for example in its console or dashboard) is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack only shows ways for external AI coding agents to read the documentation (MCP, llms.txt, Agent Skills); that is adjacent docs access, not an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
